Steps to use the plugin,

1) Download and insall (unzip) latest version of timyMCE

2) Unzip indianLanguagePlugin.zip in any folder

3) Copy indianlanguage folder within \tinymce\jscripts\tiny_mce\plugins folder of tinyMCE installation

4) Copy index.html in \tinymce\examples folder of tinyMCE installation

5) Run index.html in internet explorer browser.
